content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6–2.2 g of protein per kg of bodyweight per day. Going above that doesn't add much. Spread it over 3–5 meals, with roughly 0.3–0.4 g/kg per meal, and keep total calories at or slightly above maintenance. 💪

If you tell me your bodyweight, I'll work out your daily target for the 100 kg bench goal.
